caption:
Checked twice. Still me.

A marble sculpture's reflection in an antique gilded mirror, evening lamplight, a dark green silk robe.
#marblesculpture #newyorkcity #portrait
alt_text: Over the bare marble shoulder of a living sculpture, her reflection in an antique gilded mirror looks back calmly; she wears a dark green silk robe slipping off one shoulder and gold hoop earrings, with a glowing lamp and an armchair behind her, and a tall window of night city lights.
